# NIH NCCIH: Traditional Chinese Medicine, acupuncture, supplement safety and Herbs at a Glance

Source: National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH), National Institutes of Health (https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/), pages downloaded 2026-11-26. U.S. government work (public domain). Herbs at a Glance fact sheets give each herb's common names, what the science says, safety, side effects and cautions. Page text kept; site menus, share buttons and footers removed.
